scope: Read-only source/fresh evidence audit; no production/test edits, Sim operations or resources
whatFreshRunProves: Scene and independent controller fail unchanged with same input/profile/target; renderer synchronization and scene mesh application are not necessary to reproduce timeout.

Independent controller failure closure would fail and fulfill expectation for an observed numerical error; its expectation instead remained unfulfilled. Neither success nor failure reached that callback before timeout.
whatItDoesNotProve: Whole-test durations are not worker durations. MainActor controller test cold-initializes static synchronous solverFixture before creating expectation. Scene load also performs expensive preparation before its30second await.
No progress/timing source presently identifies whether first step, many slow steps, actor scheduling or delayed resume caused the timeout.
Raw controller fixture initializes RopeDynamicsSolver directly; scene uses prepareDisplay/projectInitialization first. Same input/target does not imply identical initialized state.

sourceFindings.actorIsolation: Worker is custom actor, solver is Sendable struct, controller Task inherits MainActor but awaits worker. Project Swift5.0/-Onone, no SWIFT_DEFAULT_ACTOR_ISOLATION setting. Source does not show numerical solve executing on MainActor.
sourceFindings.loopBound: Immediate settle computes up to1200fixed steps synchronously within worker actor; earliest settled criterion needs0.5simulated seconds (~120steps). No intermediate frame is returned.
sourceFindings.nestedCost: Each step may perform80constraint corrections, each up to16line-search merit attempts, contact working-set solve/fallback bounds up to2048, plus recursive dt retries to depth4.
sourceFindings.contactEnumeration: Self-contact enumerates all pairs of links before spatial rejection.550mm loop with <=2mm links has>=275links, or about37k candidate pairs each enumeration. Repeated manifold/merit calls can be costly in-Onone; actual iteration counts unknown.
sourceFindings.collider: Closest/inside/contact queries use BVH; do not misdescribe every call as exhaustive10200triangle scan.
sourceFindings.cancellation: Checks at worker entry/exit and between outer settling steps; no checks within expensive inner correction/contact/merit loops. A canceled prior scene worker may keep consuming CPU until its current step returns; contention is plausible but unmeasured.
sourceFindings.fixtureCost: Controller static fixture builds collider/seed synchronously on main test actor before awaiting delivery; seed rebuilds routes twice+17bisections and AStar geometry search each time.343seconds outside await could be cold fixture cost/CPU contention. Not evidence of343second blocked delivery.

primaryHypothesis: Native full-resolution numerical solve is still inside a costly step/settling sequence when30wallseconds expires, possibly compounded by preceding canceled step work and cold fixture preparation.
hypothesisStatus: Unconfirmed runtime boundary; source alone insufficient for final implementation fix

minimalBoundedInstrumentation.purpose: Demonstrate main actor remains responsive during numerical solve.

samplingGate: Parent may sample exact owned-device test processPID for3seconds into workspace-owned artifact after worker-entry trace. Verify exactPID from owned-device process/log before sampling; capture no shared/unknown process. Sampling avoids instrumenting every numerical hot loop.
decisionGates: No worker entry => investigate Task scheduling/actor context before modifying solver.
Worker entered, heartbeat continues, step progress slow/no return => sample CPU and optimize confirmed hot phase without changing physical/topological acceptance.
Worker returns accepted frame, controller resumed but identity false => targeted lifecycle/token fix with reproduction of that exact rejection.
Worker throws numerical error before timeout => fix underlying numeric/fixture initialization cause; never convert unsupported raw seed into accepted frame.
No heartbeat despite worker entry => use stack evidence to distinguish main actor blocking from cooperative executor starvation.
